title: Malaysia cumulative mean revenue loss (unscaled evidence)
limitations: No cumulative (two-year) Malaysia mean revenue loss cell exists in the evidence packet, and summing the two annual means is an unsupported recomputation not provided as verified evidence.
The packet contains no unit-conversion evidence; expressing the Malaysia losses in millions of dollars would require a conversion not available in this fixed-evidence baseline.
Historical input provenance is incomplete and the assessment is inspection-only (not recomputable).
The mean losses are signed estimates; gains are retained in signed means, and these are not tail measures such as VaR or ES.
Assessments are conditional on the stated macroeconomic path and do not represent total-economy loss, sovereign default probability, or causal attribution.
